purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: New Capital
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: New Urban Communities Authority and Administrative Capital for Urban Development oversee city development and plot allocation; Egyptian Survey Authority is national mapping/cadastre institution.
registryBasis: Official NUCA New Capital and land-plot pages document a city plot inventory and land-administration activity. Available/reserved plot records do not by themselves establish a legal title register or public cadastral vector geometry.
findings: Official NUCA pages identify the New Administrative Capital and its land-plot/zone portal. Search results describe the portal as a buyer-facing plot-detail service. Fresh web.open of the unparameterized zone page returned an Invalid Zone ID page; no city/zone identifier or point query was available. This is not evidence that data are absent. No open parcel polygon endpoint or returned geometry was verified, and no private buyer information was entered.
